findings.reason: Admissibility gap lets an invisible payload pass the approval diff and reach the agent, so the user does not approve the exact change; this is incorrect behavior in the goal-named plan/approval path.
The rendered placeholder points to doctor, which reports 'all admissible' for uncovered render parts; that is a misleading result in the goal-named instruction-stack path.
The sanctioned `plan instructions set|clear` plans successfully but always fails at apply on a non-UTF-8 existing file, so the goal-named plan/apply path does not correctly edit that source.
A bytes-only change (line endings or trailing newline) shows an empty diff, so the user approves a change they cannot see; this is a misleading result in the goal-named approval path.
This is a narrow install/uninstall bookkeeping edge case (pre-existing hook, lost manifest) in setup ownership, not in a behavior the goal names.
Raw old-file bytes (ESC sequences, bare CRs) reach the terminal in the diff the user is approving, which is a misleading result in the goal-named approval path.
The hook-cap estimate duplicates write_agents' placement rules and under-counts on rename; the goal does not name cap warnings, so this is a structure and dedup improvement outside it.
